causal_design.decision: 09:35 d uses O_d and features/sigma[d-1]; C_d and later observations excluded.
causal_design.precommitment: Close d and opening d+1 masks committed at09:35 d; actual sizing may use fill NAV, not future mask selection.
causal_design.labels: Paired origin d outcomes mature at C[d+1]; strict annual cutoffs and paired-endpoint purge before validation-origin decision.
causal_design.terminal: Charge regular Sep30 close trade at Sep30; zero-time fee row creates no market session/return/label and must not inflate bootstrap dates.
causal_design.missingness: No future-path eligibility, window shrink, fund substitution, neutral signal or free forced exit.
